text:
- New to Marvel comics? Open the new guide from Home or an empty Library for starter picks and two optional Reading Lists.
- Finishing a Reading List gives you a clearer next step, with the next Modern Timeline list and related stories with cover previews.
- Adds Siege, Realm of Kings, Fall of the Hulks and World War Hulks, and three Captain America (2025) reading lists. Expands the Amazing Spider-Man guide.
- Buttons, links and cards show a pressed edge while you hold them. Screen changes fade in gently and honor reduced-motion settings.
- Your saved reading progress, notes and backups remain compatible and need no migration.
